deviations.description: Hard branch (planned/implementing per-phase H1 dispatch) prompt: plan says 'No description, briefing, memory block, contract text, or plan path appears in the lead's prompt at any site.'
deviations.reason: This one site's phase_mission_block (mission line: 'Implement phase N only', 'PHASES COMPLETED: n of m') is genuinely per-cycle content (next_phase, phases_completed, phases_total) that orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh does not gather -- it was never one of Stage 3.5's four blocks nor one of Phase 4's enumerated per-dispatch gatherers. Dropping it entirely without adding it to the dispatch file would violate the plan's own MUST NOT ('a generated dispatch file must carry every input the current inline recipe would have interpolated' / 'must never change what an agent receives semantically'). Kept it authored inline at this ONE site (already tiny, ~200 bytes) and appended to the fixed pointer prompt, rather than expanding the script's scope to gather it. Every other component (memory/lit/effort/hard-contracts) still moved to the dispatch file exactly like the other 7 sites.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: hard branch also appends phase_mission_block, which is genuinely per-cycle content the script does not gather (next_phase/phases_completed/phases_total) -- see Phase 6 progress deviations)*
